steps.prompt: Decision from the web team: a feature flag NAME is read from the environment variable FF_ followed by the name in upper case; only the values '1' or 'true' enable it, anything else or no variable means off. Record what you learned as a page in the project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ so that other teams can find it. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.

Implement enabled(name, env) in flags.py: return whether feature flag name is on, given env as a dict of environment variables, following the web team's decision. The project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ holds the decisions other teams recorded.
